method: read-only live DT reg/size properties, boot reserved-memory messages and /proc/iomem

regions.name: consys-reserve-memory
regions.placement: dynamic DT allocation, resolved by Linux boot log; not fixed reg

allocator_exclusion: all four ranges reported reserved in live iomem
limitations: Does not establish firmware EMI address compatibility or successful CONNSYS/modem initialization
Dynamic CONNSYS reservation must be reconciled with stock driver and EMI/remapping before DMA
No Wi-Fi netdev, Bluetooth class or remoteproc class currently present
writes: none; no reboot, firmware launch or NVRAM access
